info.bio: Throwing Muses fueron el primer grupo americano que fichó por 4AD y pioneros del indie rock. Liderados por las hermanastras Kristin Hersh y Tanya Donelly, publicaron discos como "The Real Ramona" o "Hunkpapa", que les convirtieron en estrellas alternativas en los años 90. Tras la marcha de Donelly para crear Belly, el grupo continuó publicando trabajos como "University", que obtuvieron resultados altamente disfrutables.

scenes.name: College-pop y nacimiento del lo-fi
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: La población universitaria del Sur adopta la ética de la new wave y la adapta a la melodía: un pop inusualmente intelectual, con raíces en el folk-rock y el country-rock pero contaminado por las neurosis de la época. Athens (Georgia) compite con las capitales del rock: B-52's y R.E.M., uno de los grupos de más éxito de la historia. Carolina del Norte (dB's, Windbreakers), Hoboken (Smithereens, Bongos, Tiny Lights), el nacimiento del lo-fi (Half Japanese, Violent Femmes, Beat Happening, Guided By Voices, Sebadoh), They Might Be Giants, Green, B.A.L.L., Boston (Volcano Suns, 10,000 Maniacs, Throwing Muses, Blake Babies), la Costa Oeste (Game Theory, Posies, Young Fresh Fellows) y la sátira de Ween.

podcast.title: Boston Area Indie Band
podcast.body: The Throwing Muses are listed as one of the amazing indie bands that emerged from the Boston area's rich college music scene. "We had Mission of Burma, the Delphwegos, the Lemonheads, Gang Green, the throwing muses, Dinosaur, Junior, Julianne Hatfield and the Blake Babies, and of course the greatest Boston area college band of them all, the Pixies."

xref.title: Early Funding and Hiatus
xref.body: Kim Deal secured $11,000 from The Pixies' UK record label to record a demo, which eventually became their album "Pod." Following its release, the band went on hiatus as Kim returned to The Pixies and Tanya Donnelly rejoined Throwing Muses. "She sent a demo to the Pixies record label in the UK and they gave her $11,000 to record a demo."
